intro-subtitle: Playing with shapes, crossing the border between the real and the imaginary or stepping through a looking glass: Cartier approaches time from the perspective of a magician.
manifest-subtitle: Playing with shapes, crossing the border between the real and the imaginary or stepping through a looking glass: Cartier approaches time from the perspective of a magician.
manifest-edito-subtitle: Cartier is the watchmaker of shapes. The Maison has always distinguished itself through the creation of unique forms, beginning with the design and crafting silhouettes that fit to instantly recognizable shapes.
manifest-edito-paragraph: Like an alchemist, Cartier transforms matter into personal and precious objects of desire. These, in turn, carry intangible feelings, bear irreplaceable memories and elevate our souls. Some watch mechanisms are marked by a true mystery, seeming too impossible to be real, but they nonetheless are.
manifest-edito-paragraph2: Hence, the true magic lies in the very existence of these watchmaking creations (or: timepieces). Carrying an inevitable design, Cartier watches emerge as essential creations: they are meant to be. Cartier reveals the wonders of the world, as much as it creates them. Cartier is a true magician.
manifest-edito-author: Cyrille Vigneron, President and CEO, Cartier International
icon-subheadline: When magic takes design into the sublime.
icon-paragraph: Panthère de Cartier, Baignoire, Tank Américaine and Tank Louis Cartier: the Maison’s watchmaking icons are transformed as if by magic.
icon-block-image1-text: In a mini version, the Tank Louis Cartier cultivates its timeless elegance.
icon-block-image2-text: The Panthère de Cartier watch multiplies precious sensations with a sparkling dial and a new bracelet whose links alternate between satin-finish and grained gold.
icon-block-image3-text: The Tank Américaine accentuates its graphic dial, drawing a new geometry of time in black and gold.
icon-block-image4-text: Cartier explores the signature oval dial of the Baignoire watch, transposing it onto a bangle.
icon-paragraph4: Tank, Panthère de Cartier, Baignoire: they have the same capacity to reinvent themselves, always with more to say; their creative energy is inexhaustible and so Cartier dares to evolve them with the times.
reflexion-subheadline: Between watchmaking and jewellery, this watch goes where time plays with appearances.
reflexion-paragraph: Magic unsettles perceptions of time. Sometimes it's an optical phenomenon, like the Reflection de Cartier watch, which shifts the real into the imaginary.
reflexion-paragraph2: The Reflection de Cartier watch features a face-to-face encounter between a delicate dial and a mirror - where time seems to be running backwards.
reflexion-paragraph4: With its openwork bracelet and the bevelled crystal of its dial, the Reflection de Cartier watch links the Maison’s watchmaking and jewellery expertise. This generous architecture inaugurates the combination of a snow setting and an inverted setting, which multiplies the brilliance of the stones.
santos-subheadline: A collection that carries on the spirit, style and magic of the aviator Santos-Dumont.
santos-paragraph: Magic invites us to play with the mystery of time through the Santos-Dumont Rewind watch, capable of counting time backwards. The Santos de Cartier Dual Time watch allows time to be measured in two different places in the same moment.
santos-subtitle2: Santos de Cartier dual time watch
santos-paragraph2: Equipped with a self-winding mechanical movement that merges two time zones, the Santos de Cartier Dual Time watch allows a simultaneous reading of time.
santos-block-image1-text: Made in a limited edition of 200 pieces, the Santos-Dumont Rewind watch has the 230 MC reverse-wound manual mechanical movement whose hands can be moved backwards instead of forwards.
santos-paragraph4: The Santos-Dumont Rewind watch features a carnelian dial whose subtle nuances highlight the precious character of this platinum watch. The Santos de Cartier Dual Time watch pays attention to its details: rhodium-plated sword hands covered with luminescent material, a crown with seven faceted sides, and a grey counter displaying a second adjustable time zone.
private-subheadline: The collectors' rendez-vous unveils the Tortue watch, equipped with a single-push chronograph.
private-paragraph: Magic continuously infuses its transformative power into the Maison's great classics, which are constantly being reinvented, such as the Tortue Monopoussoir Chronographe watch from the Cartier Privé collection.
private-paragraph2: This new single-button chronograph version integrates three functions - start, stop and reset - into a push-button set in the crown, activated with a single motion. The movement is 4.3 mm thick, making it the Maison's thinnest chronograph.
private-paragraph4: The open back of the Tortue Monopoussoir Chronographe watch reveals the fascinating spectacle of the Manufacture 1928 MC movement. It displays the column wheel, an essential component that regulates the functions of the different levers and represents a real challenge in terms of production and adjustment.
chimera-subheadline: A signature source of inspiration for the Maison, this watch blends zebra and crocodile in a lozenge-shaped case.
chimera-paragraph: Magic provokes unexpected encounters between figuration and abstraction, as with this animal jewellery watch, which transforms Cartier's fauna and unsettles perceptions.
chimera-paragraph2: In the great tradition of the Maison's animal watches, Cartier has created a fascinating chimera, born from the meeting of the zebra and the crocodile. The imaginary creature encircles a lozenge-shaped dial - as if to better embrace it.
chimera-paragraph4: A fully-paved watch that is both graphic and organic, each stripe defined in lacquer by hand. The Maison’s savoir-faire is demonstrated through the delicately carved decoration that surrounds each coloured stone.
